sources.articleTitle: Somalia to Begin Issuing EAC e-Passports in January 2027

headline: Somalia Set To Introduce East African Community E-Passports In 2027
seoTitle: Somalia To Start Issuing EAC E-Passports
metaDescription: Somalia is scheduled to begin issuing East African Community e-passports starting in January 2027 to improve regional travel and border security measures.
aiSummaryBullets: Somalia will launch the issuance of EAC e-passports starting in January 2027.
The new travel documents aim to simplify movement across the East African region.
Officials stated the initiative intends to support cross-border trade and strengthen national border security.
aiContextParagraph: Somalia is preparing to implement the East African Community (EAC) e-passport system, with official issuance scheduled to commence in January 2027. This transition is part of a broader regional effort to standardize travel documentation across EAC member states. The introduction of these electronic passports is intended to facilitate more efficient cross-border movement for citizens, which is expected to support regional employment opportunities and increase trade activity. Furthermore, the authorities emphasize that the new passport system will play a crucial role in bolstering border security protocols. By integrating these travel documents, Somalia aims to enhance its integration within the East African bloc and streamline administrative processes for international travelers within the region. The move reflects the ongoing integration goals of the community, focusing on collective economic development and improved migration management between neighboring territories.
